name: vault-publisher
description: The Vault Studio Portal: publishes game builds to the Vault Learning Games CDN (Cloudflare R2), and builds and previews the Vault website (site/).

scripts.site:build: npm run site:catalog && hugo --source site --buildDrafts --cleanDestinationDir && node site/scripts/squarespace-paths.mjs
scripts.site:dev: npm run site:catalog; hugo server --source site --buildDrafts --port 1313
